description: This file defines protocols, extensions, and support functions for location services using CoreLocation in Swift. It provides abstractions for managing location updates, requesting location once, and handling authorization status.

methods.name: configureLocationManager
methods.description: Configures the CLLocationManager by setting delegate and desired accuracy.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current authorization status for location services.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Provides the accuracy authorization for the location manager.

methods.name: requestLocationOnce
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a single location update.
